text: Implemented design_model()/raw_design_model(), observation_model(), plan_relation(), portable design receipts, relation_plan_receipts(), and estimate(). Added explicit QR/SVD routes to legacy lm_extractor/lm_relation_fit without changing defaults. Semantic cell+QR and treatment+SVD plans share relation_plan_id, receipts and fit signatures differ, fitted relations agree at 1e-12, fixed GLS earns the admitted error channel, learned-frozen GLS withholds it, and raw X/T is narrower. Full source suite passes; installed R CMD check = 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes.
